text:
Posted by Vivian Park 19 pm Green Brick Partners, Inc. (NASDAQ:GRBK) Ratings Coverage
Among 3 analysts covering Green Brick Partners ( NASDAQ:GRBK ), 1 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 2 Hold. Therefore 33% are positive. Green Brick Partners had 5 analyst reports since July 23, 2018 according to SRatingsIntel. The rating was upgraded by Citigroup on Thursday, August 9 to “Buy”. Citigroup maintained Green Brick Partners, Inc. (NASDAQ:GRBK) on Monday, July 23 with “Neutral” rating. The firm earned “Neutral” rating on Tuesday, December 18 by Credit Suisse. The stock increased 1.32% or $0.1 during the last trading session, reaching $7.67. About 116,288 shares traded. Green Brick Partners, Inc. (NASDAQ:GRBK) has declined 28.76% downtrending. It has underperformed by 28.76% the S&P500.
Green Brick Partners, Inc. engages in the homebuilding business in the United States. The company has market cap of $389.02 million. It operates through two divisions, Builder Operations and Land Development. It has a 13.07 P/E ratio. The firm is involved in the land acquisition and development, entitlements, design, construction, marketing, and sale of various residential projects, such as town, single family, and luxury homes in master planned communities; development of lots for public and large private builders; and land and construction financing business.
